reconcile.note: Gill reads the oracle as fulfilled first, Zedekiah saw the king of Babylon's eyes at Riblah, and only after that were his eyes put out.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible presses the plain wording, Jeremiah promises Zedekiah will see the king's eyes while Kings reports his eyes were put out first.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible.

sides.snippet: They killed the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and put out the eyes of Zedekiah, and bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon.
sides.verseText: They killed the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and put out the eyes of Zedekiah, and bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon.

sides.snippet: your eyes shall see the eyes of the king of Babylon
sides.verseText: and you shall not escape out of his hand, but shall surely be taken, and delivered into his hand; and your eyes shall see the eyes of the king of Babylon, and he shall speak with you mouth to mouth, and you shall go to Babylon.
